task.reason: Reminder reasoning and projection will apply to every current and future Personal OS task intake surface.

No installed capability owns per-Task Calendar reminder policy, and Codex heartbeat automation would create a parallel reminder path.

queries: Google Calendar API reminders overrides useDefault popup minutes
Google Calendar Events update reminders valid range
Google Tasks REST task due date time discarded

evidence.summary: Google Calendar supports user-specific per-event reminder overrides. Setting useDefault=false with popup overrides projects reminder offsets to web and mobile clients.
Event reminders are writable on update, and each offset is expressed as 0 through 40320 minutes before Event start, so reminder changes can preserve the Event id.
Google Tasks discards the time portion of due. It cannot be the exact-time reminder projection layer.
Supabase Cron can schedule server jobs, but native phone delivery would still require a separate push application, device tokens, and notification lifecycle.

evidence.summary: Google's supported Node client models Event reminders and overrides, but the current Deno Edge code already calls the same REST API safely without this dependency.
Supabase documents and ships Cron integration, but it does not provide the user's iPhone notification channel or Personal OS semantic reminder policy.

comparison.reason: The existing deterministic Calendar Event is the only candidate that satisfies dynamic per-task timing, current OAuth and iPhone delivery, stable ids, no duplicate Task/Event, and no parallel notification source of truth.
comparison.fewer_than_three_waiver: Only one candidate meets all hard constraints. Calendar defaults are not semantic, Google Tasks cannot retain an exact reminder time, and custom push would introduce a new application and delivery system.

decision.reason: Extend task_schedule_metadata, the shared schedule projection core, unified Intake/MCP schemas, and the existing Calendar PATCH/upsert path. Keep Google Tasks as Task truth and store reminder policy only as attached Schedule metadata.
